description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an urgent opening for a leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for nursing staff. If you are ready to make a significant impact and drive clinical excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This role offers a competitive salary and the opportunity to shape the future of patient services within a dynamic healthcare setting. Join a team committed to quality and compassionate care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
Excellent clinical assessment, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
